roster.title: Assistant Professor
areas: The Creative Intelligence and Synergy (CIS) Lab at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of computer graphics, human-computer interaction, and artificial intelligence, with a focus on algorithms and systems for digital content creation. Our current research topics include sketching, VR/AR/XR, generative techniques, and multimodal creativity, with applications in art, design, perception, and cultural heritage.
• Drawing analysis and intelligent interfaces, including non-photorealistic rendering, sketch-based modeling, and AI-assisted drawing
• Virtual/augmented/extended reality, including efficient 3D capture, processing, and editing, spatial interfaces, and digital twin
• AI content generation, including neural rendering, digital humans, procedural modeling, and multimodal AI creativity
